parameters.note: Grouse Lakes (plural) is a small cluster in the northern Desolation Wilderness near Phipps Lake and Rubicon Lake — a distinct water from the more popular singular 'Grouse Lake' near Wrights Lake in southern Desolation. It is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). It sits near the Sierra crest in the Lake Tahoe basin; the general Lake Tahoe tributaries rule §7.50(b)(152) closes Tahoe tributaries (e.g. Meeks and General creeks) only 'upstream to the first lake', so it does not reach these upstream lakes, which follow the general lake regulation.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.citation: USDA Forest Service — Desolation Wilderness permit program

parameters.description: Grouse Lakes lies inside Desolation Wilderness. A USDA Forest Service wilderness permit is required year-round for overnight use; a quota applies to overnight destination zones from the Friday before Memorial Day through September 30. Day use is free and unlimited by quota, with a self-issue permit required only when permit boxes are installed at the trailheads (day-use permits are not required in winter, roughly October–March). Bear canisters are required for all overnight visitors.

raw.day_use: free, no quota; self-issue permit when trailhead boxes installed
raw.overnight_quota_season: Friday before Memorial Day through September 30

parameters.description: Fishery note. No authoritative source (CDFW survey or stocking record) documents fish in this specific 'Grouse Lakes' cluster near Phipps and Rubicon lakes, and it is not in CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking plan; CDFW ended aerial stocking of Desolation Wilderness lakes, so many high lakes here are barren or hold only relict populations. Angler reports of abundant brook trout in Desolation apply to the separate, similarly-named singular 'Grouse Lake' near Wrights Lake, not this feature. Current fish presence here is undocumented — species left empty rather than assumed.

raw.note: distinct from 'Grouse Lake' near Wrights Lake

candidates.summary: No current stocking and no documented fishery for this specific water; not to be confused with the brook-trout 'Grouse Lake' near Wrights Lake.
